scripts.d1:subscribers: wrangler d1 execute pbidocs-subscribers --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_subscribers FROM subscribers;"
scripts.d1:subscribers:recent: wrangler d1 execute pbidocs-subscribers --remote --command "SELECT email, created_at FROM subscribers ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;"
scripts.d1:feedback: wrangler d1 execute pbidocs-subscribers --remote --command "SELECT page, SUM(CASE WHEN helpful = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS helpful_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN helpful = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_helpful_votes, COUNT(*) AS total_votes FROM page_feedback GROUP BY page ORDER BY total_votes DESC;"
scripts.d1:feedback:negative: wrangler d1 execute pbidocs-subscribers --remote --command "SELECT page, SUM(CASE WHEN helpful = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_helpful_votes, COUNT(*) AS total_votes FROM page_feedback GROUP BY page HAVING not_helpful_votes > 0 ORDER BY not_helpful_votes DESC LIMIT 20;"
